title: Tenant origin affinity controller and automated evidence exports
creator: Marcus Liu
description: Deliver a tenant-scoped origin affinity controller for the Hosted API that provides declarative residency preferences, deterministic fallback behavior, and a scheduled, tamper-evident evidence export pipeline. Goals: 1) Expose API and Console controls for three residency modes (strict, prefer, flex) per tenant and per-endpoint; 2) Implement server-side enforcement with routing policies that add request-level region stamps and a region-decider that supports soft-failover and capacity-aware fallbacks; 3) Build an automated evidence exporter that packages periodic attestation bundles (request sample + routing decisions + retention proof) and publishes signed artifacts for auditors; 4) Provide migration tools for tenants currently using ad-hoc region preferences and for Dedicated customers that want an identical control surface.
comments: 2026-02-22 - Kickoff: Product, Eng, and Security sync. Alignment on three residency modes: strict (hard lock), prefer (soft affinity with consented fallback), flex (best-effort regional preference). Action: Eng to prototype routing hook with region_hint header.

2026-03-01 - Design feedback from UX: Console should show pin history and automated proof snapshots. PM asked for a lightweight 'affinity preview' modal to simulate routing impact before applying changes.

2026-03-05 - Engineering update: Prototype of region-decider landed in internal branch (github.com/redwood-inference/roadmap/pull/1123). It includes capacity score and TTL-based cache for decisions. Known gap: request-level logging needs a compact schema for evidence bundles.

2026-03-08 - Security review (preliminary): Recommended HMAC signing of export packs, include KMS key identifier, and retention-proof manifests with SHA256 digest. Security asked for explicit threat model for cross-region data egress during fallback — Eng to propose mitigations.

2026-03-11 - PM note: Acceptance criteria drafted. Requires (a) API flags: residency_mode, region_hint, enforcement_policy; (b) Console CRUD for tenant affinity presets; (c) Evidence export containing: sample requests (anonymized), routing decisions, timestamped attestations, and export manifest; (d) End-to-end test for strict mode showing denial or queueing when pinned region capacity is insufficient.
2026-03-13 - Next steps: Schedule two-week canary with 3 low-risk tenants and run exporter nightly to S3 staging bucket. Prepare runbook for rollback and capacity throttles.
acceptance_criteria: API: residency_mode (strict|prefer|flex) accepted on tenant settings and per-route override
Routing: decisions logged with region_stamp, decision_reason, and fallback_reason when applicable
Evidence Export: nightly signed bundles with manifest.json, sha256 checksums, and anonymized request samples
Console: affinity preset UI with preview simulator and history view
Tests: automated integration tests that assert strict mode blocks cross-region routing and prefer mode records fallback events
Docs: public docs and compliance FAQ updated with export format and retention semantics
